'''Bosph''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Bosph (species)|Bosph]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Located in the [[Bosph sector/Legends|Bosph sector]], it was discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] several decades before the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. Due to the Bosphs' [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Harsh]] [[Bombardment of Bosph/Legends|bombarded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The Bosphs went into denial, pretending the bombardment had never occurred; though in reality, the planet was almost completely destroyed. After this, the planet itself was covered in grassy plains broken by the scars of [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire.
